name: Unidentified IG droid (Ord Mantell)
description: An IG droid was guarding a shipment of prototype blaster pistols on a 20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport on Ord Mantell. Boba Fett, sent by Jabba Desilijic Tiure to steal the prototypes, disabled the droid using a reprogrammed MSE-6 series repair droid.
